data.title: Exam-rigging suspects freed as investigators miss deadline
data.description: Three key suspects in the civil service exam-rigging scandal were released from prison on Friday after the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) failed to complete the investigation that would have supported their prosecution.

data.title: Indian ‘cockroach’ leaders detained ahead of major protest
data.description: NEW DELHI - Indian police detained the head of the satirical Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) online movement on Saturday ahead of a major protest it called against the Election Commission, the party said.

data.title: 11 foreign suspects arrested in nominee crackdown

data.title: Three Mexicans convicted of murdering Australian, US surfers

data.title: Think pink
data.description: Thailand has long been recognised as one of the world's most LGBTI-friendly countries. That is not an understatement. Not only does the country have progressive policies in support of gender diversity such as the anticipated 2024 marriage equality law and the Gender Equality Act, Thailand also lays a solid foundation for the "Pink Tech" economy.

data.title: The need for climate-ready schools
data.description: Flooding across Thailand is disrupting children's education, with schools forced to close in affected areas and some classrooms being used as temporary shelters. The situation highlights the need to prepare schools for increasingly frequent and severe climate hazards.
